##### Project general facts

Jey Grey Residence is a visionary development by DM Projects, winner of the prestigious Asia Pacific Property Awards for its innovation, architecture, and development excellence. This exclusive complex features cabanas and townhouses built using advanced prefabricated steel-frame technology with sandwich panels, ensuring durability and seismic resistance. With a long-term leasehold structure, the project offers discerning investors a stake in one of the region’s most celebrated assets, delivering both architectural beauty and sustainable financial return.

Residents enjoy a private oasis with five-star hotel service, where neighboring villas are not visible thanks to a thoughtful master plan, high walls, and lush vegetation. Each villa features a private pool and garden, while the complex offers round-the-clock security, grounds maintenance, daily cleaning, linen replacement, appliance upkeep, and utility management. A professional management company handles marketing, booking, rental collection, and monthly reporting, ensuring a seamless hands-off investment experience.

Every villa at Jey Grey Residence is a masterpiece of modern minimalist design, featuring open layouts, high ceilings, and panoramic glazing that unites indoor and outdoor living. Interiors are finished with wood-polymer composite wall panels, large-format porcelain stoneware floors, and premium fixtures. Kitchens feature built-in handleless facades with bar counters, complemented by modular furniture, loft-style decor, and tropical plants. Premium plumbing from Grohe and Villeroy & Boch, Legrand USB outlets, and a Daikin central air conditioning system complete the offering.

##### Parking
Shared Parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in a prime location overlooking the famous Garuda Wisnu Kencana statue, this exceptional residence offers convenient access to all the delights of the island while maintaining privacy and tranquility. The area is renowned for its cultural significance, elevated microclimate, and proximity to some of Bali’s most iconic landmarks and attractions.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning. The international airport, the cultural heart of Ubud, and the stunning beaches of the Bukit Peninsula are all within easy reach. The surrounding neighborhood features world-class resorts, fine dining, golf courses, and entertainment venues, making it highly desirable for both residents and travelers.

For those seeking a residence that embodies cultural heritage, modern convenience, and natural beauty, this location delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of iconic views, established infrastructure, and easy access to Bali’s finest offerings makes it one of the island’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, inspiring and effortlessly connected.
